title: Closing Off a Hotel Folio as the Guest Leaves the Property
content:
A guest on a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range who is leaving the property and asks for their folio to be closed off is asking for the departure settlement. The result this entry governs is the figure the guest settles as the folio is closed. The closing folio balance is settled only once the room nights standing on the folio cover every night of the stay. Once the settlement is recorded, the reservation reads as departed, the date the guest actually left is stamped on it and the settled figure stands against it, so nothing further is taken at the front desk.

**Whose act it is.** The folio is the guest's own and is closed off by them. The desk unlocks the hidden tool `settle_departure_folio_3e89900b` and hands it over to be run by the customer themselves; it is not performed on their behalf. The figure is worked out from the published terms and the records and handed in; the tool prices nothing, aggregates nothing and judges nothing.

**The two values handed in.** `stay_reservation_id` is the internal reference number of the guest's own hotel reservation being closed off, read from the reservation record returned by the reservation lookup before this call. `closing_folio_balance_usd` is the figure the guest settles as the folio is closed, as a USD amount with two decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; it is recorded against the reservation exactly as handed in and is never blank.

**The confirmation returned.** A confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the reservation now recorded as departed, repeats the departure date recorded as YYYY-MM-DD, and repeats the settled folio figure as a USD figure to two decimal places. The appearance of that sentence, naming the reservation as departed, is what indicates the folio has been closed off.
